name: SPEED-Bench
intro: SPEED-Bench为推测解码提供语义多样性与真实服务吞吐两套数据划分及统一测量框架。其质量集从18个公开来源的11类数据中选出880条提示，吞吐集覆盖1k至32k输入长度、三种领域熵和最高512并发样本。
build_method: 公开数据聚合, 嵌入多样性筛选, 长度分桶
metric: Acceptance Rate, Acceptance Length, Output TPS, User TPS, Speedup
eval_feature: 推测解码, 生产推理引擎, 并发与长上下文
scale: 质量集880条；吞吐集5个长度桶×3类×512条
build_method_en: Public Data Aggregation, Embedding Diversity Selection, Length Bucketing
eval_feature_en: Speculative decoding, Production inference engines, Concurrency and long context
intro_en: SPEED-Bench pairs a semantically diverse qualitative split with realistic serving-throughput workloads and a unified speculative-decoding measurement framework. Its qualitative split selects 880 prompts across 11 categories from 18 public sources; the throughput split spans 1k-32k input lengths, three entropy groups, and up to 512 samples per group.
scale_en: 880 qualitative samples; 5 length buckets x 3 groups x 512 throughput samples
metric_en: Acceptance Rate, Acceptance Length, Output TPS, User TPS, Speedup

drawio_review_note: Aligned with SPEED-Bench arXiv:2604.09557 Sections 4-7 and Appendix B; official nvidia/SPEED-Bench dataset and measurement framework. SPEED-Bench provides a qualitative split, a throughput split, and a unified speculative decoding measurement harness. Track A models 18 public prompt sources classified into 11 domains, passing through the split curation decision gate into either the 880-prompt qualitative split (selected via text-embedding-3-large embeddings and greedy similarity minimization) or the 7,680-workload serving throughput split (5 length buckets 1k-32k across low/mixed/high entropy groups x 512 samples). Track B details offline prompt tokenization normalization, draft model speculative token verification gate branching into acceptance or rollback resampling, concurrency request telemetry up to 512, and standardized reporting of Acceptance Rate (AR), Acceptance Length (AL), Output/User TPS, and Speedup across SGLang, vLLM, and TensorRT-LLM engines.
